entities.title: On a pull request
entities.summary: Gambit is typechecked, tested in TypeScript and GDScript, and exported; every .dev diagram and knowledge file is validated.
entities.trigger: A pull request that changes games/chess outside its .dev folders, or anything under .github/ outside .github/.dev (ci.yml).
checks: Godot 4.7.2 and its web export templates, cached by version
npm test: tsc --noEmit, then the node:test suites in test/
npm run test:godot: import, then tests/test_rules.gd and tests/test_formats.gd headless
npm run build: the Godot web export, the engine split into parts, bridge.js and Stockfish
No .dev folders in dist/: the build must not ship the folders' documentation
python3 Meta/Agents/Skills/validate_diagrams.py, for the whole repository
The Database migration check, when worker/schema.sql or worker/migrations/ change
notChecked: How the game looks: the reference renders are compared by hand.
The game in a real browser, the GameRoom's WebSockets, Stockfish, and the login service.
worker/retire-sessions.sql, which the migration check does not watch.

entities.title: Deploying, by hand
entities.summary: Nothing deploys from GitHub: the owner runs npm run deploy in this folder, which runs the tests and the build, then wrangler deploy.
entities.trigger: The owner, on their own machine (the Deploy workflow was removed on 2026-11-23).
checks: Any database migration this change needs, applied first by hand (docs/database-migrations.md)
secrets: The owner's wrangler login, or a Cloudflare API token, for the icelander.net account
